limitations: Authored choreography informed by visible references; no source choreography reconstruction or hidden-foot motion capture claimed.

package_evidence.policy: Embed the original full JSON report content, retaining its recorded source-byte hash, in the final delivery evidence. Keep large NPZ/NPY captures and per-time data out of Git; this ledger summarizes their measured results and exact identities.
